description: This file appears to be a shell script that defines various functions for interacting with a Git repository, such as tagging, creating commits, replacing sha1 hashes with symbolic names, setting author or committer dates, and running tests. It seems to be part of a script-based tooling or testing framework related to Git operations.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies and retrieves the hash for a given Git tag, or errors if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Generates a unique commit using provided text and tree, referencing a specific tag's commit.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Updates a tag in Git to point to a new commit created from command output and prepends substitution scripting for sha1 hashes.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces unhelpful sha1 hashes in input with their symbolic equivalents according to sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Runs a command with the GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL environment variable temporarily set to a specified value.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Retrieves the commit date of a specified commit hash.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date string to a variable, handling default or partial date formats.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs a command with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE set to a specific date.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs a command with both GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and GIT_AUTHOR_DATE set to specified dates.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Executes a command while suppressing error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs a command, checks its output against expected content, and compares actual vs. expected output.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Converts a description string into a normalized test name.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test command with expected output, verifying success and matching expected results.
